scope: Direct strategy report generator location scope and unlineaged fork evidence
finding: Location-required strategy report generators could be called directly with a missing location, bypassing CLI validation; several downstream helpers then queried all locations. stakeholder_outcomes additionally exposed a network-wide architecture view. Fork detection included insight_transfer records with no location lineage even when invoked for one farm.
change: All 18 location-required strategy report generators now reject missing or empty location_id before opening a cursor or delegating. stakeholder_outcomes always binds the selected location and omits its unlineaged network architecture view. Location-scoped fork detection now excludes global insight_transfer rows; network-wide detection without a location continues to include them. Explicit network-level reports remain unchanged.

checks.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_strategy_report_location_guards.py tests/test_stakeholder_outcomes_scope.py tests/test_tactical_layer.py tests/test_report_generator_cli.py tests/test_comprehensive_status.py tests/test_report_state_error_redaction.py -q
checks.fork_scope_regression: passed: unlineaged insight_transfer forks remain available in network-wide detection and are excluded from location-scoped output

rollback: Restore the prior strategy report guards, stakeholder_outcomes query, fork detector branch, focused tests, and this evidence file; no migration or persisted data changed.
limitations: The location guard is a scope correctness check, not an authorization or tenant-isolation boundary.
Network-wide capability/value-stream links remain outside stakeholder_outcomes and are available through the separate network-level stakeholder_value_streams report.
Location-scoped fork reports intentionally omit insight_transfer evidence until that table has a trustworthy location lineage.
